title: UzDB 0.1.6 tooling blockers resolved at 0.3.52; current blocker is memory-model + codegen stability
content: The original UzDB feedback letter (E:\UzmiGames\UzDB\docs\letter-to-tml-dev.md, TML 0.1.6) blockers are all fixed at 0.3.52: pipe hangs/stderr routing, MCP timeout, match ICE (now a diagnostic in parser_expr.cpp:607), U128/I128 Display, File::sync/datasync, msgpack module, BTreeMapIter Iterator impl, int-literal inference. Do not re-litigate these. What actually blocks real applications now: (1) memory-model unsoundness (double-free class, see companion learning), (2) standing K001 invalid-IR failures in std/collections (btreemap/btreeset/arraylist), hir_types, infer_differential, c_preprocessor, (3) X002 hangs on let_patterns/slice_split_pred/builtins_imports and X003 on closure_codegen, (4) non-deterministic heap-layout-dependent crashes (essential.c 0/5, c_essential_repro.c 28/30). Corrective roadmap with gates: docs/analysis/tml-table-analysis/06-execution-plan.md (freeze phases 35-38, determinism harness + LLVM verifier in CI, then memory-model ADR-009 decision, then codegen, then UzDB-core soak test as acceptance).
